aal_roi_timeseries_status: FOUND (mechanism/documentation CONFIRMED; exact 780-cohort overlap NOT YET EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED)
aal_atlas_status: NOT FOUND locally; PCP-internal atlas referenced but not independently downloadable/verified as a standalone file
same_780_cohort_coverage: UNCERTAIN (INFERRED likely yes for CPAC, unconfirmed for DPARSF -- requires one small metadata fetch to confirm)
best_verified_option: Option A2 (ABIDE PCP rois_aal, DPARSF pipeline) pending verification; Option A (CPAC) as a faster-to-confirm fallback
large_download_required: NO (the identified AAL-116 ROI resource is a small, ~190-200MB estimated download, NOT hundreds of GB; a full raw-data route (Option D) WOULD be large and is not recommended)
decision_reason: A legitimate, well-documented AAL-116 ROI time-series source (ABIDE PCP's rois_aal derivative, accessible through the already-installed nilearn.fetch_abide_pcp) was verified to exist for all four of the paper's pipelines, confirmed directly from the installed package's source code and corroborated by the official PCP GitHub repository. This is a materially better position than Phase 3.5's local-only finding. However, its exact overlap with our specific 780-subject Phase-2 cohort has NOT been empirically verified -- confirming it requires at minimum a small phenotypic-metadata fetch (and, for full confidence, the actual ~190-200MB rois_aal download), neither of which has been performed in this investigation, per the explicit rule to stop and report before any download.
recommended_next_step: Approve a SMALL, explicitly-scoped verification step (not yet performed): fetch only the DPARSF (and/or CPAC) phenotypic metadata via fetch_abide_pcp to confirm subject-ID overlap with the 780-subject Phase-2 cohort, before committing to the full ~190-200MB rois_aal ROI data download. This keeps the investigation-only posture of Phase 3.6 while resolving the one remaining unknown blocking a FEASIBLE determination.

download_disclosure_not_executed.WHAT: AAL-116 ROI time series (.1D files) via nilearn.datasets.fetch_abide_pcp(pipeline='cpac' or 'dparsf', derivatives=['rois_aal'], strategy matching filt_global or the paper's specified strategy)
download_disclosure_not_executed.WHY: This is the only verified, documented, legitimate AAL-116 ROI time-series source identified for ABIDE-I; it uses the same mechanism/S3 bucket already used successfully for our existing CC200 data, so it is the most direct path to real AAL-116 features without a full raw-data preprocessing effort.
download_disclosure_not_executed.SIZE: Estimated ~190-200MB for the CPAC/full-cohort case, based on scaling from the existing 871-file, 338MB rois_cc200 set (200 regions/file) to 116 regions/file. This is an ESTIMATE, not a measured size -- actual size unconfirmed until fetched.
download_disclosure_not_executed.COVERAGE: CPAC: INFERRED ~871 subjects (same as existing phenotypic_qc.csv), pending verification. DPARSF: UNCERTAIN subject count, requires its own phenotypic check.
download_disclosure_not_executed.PIPELINE: CPAC (matches our existing Phase 1-3 choice) or DPARSF (matches the paper's reported best-performing pipeline) -- your choice affects which is fetched.
download_disclosure_not_executed.ATLAS: AAL (aal_mask_pad.nii.gz per PCP's own pipeline config) -- exact version/region-count NOT independently confirmed against the paper's methodology (see Step 5).
download_disclosure_not_executed.COHORT_OVERLAP: INFERRED high overlap with the 780-subject Phase-2 cohort for CPAC (same phenotypic source); UNCONFIRMED for DPARSF.
download_disclosure_not_executed.REPRODUCTION_IMPACT: This would be the FIRST genuine AAL-116 ROI data available in this project, directly enabling Phase 4 (Pearson correlation + Fisher-Z + SVM-RFE + SSAE) on real AAL features rather than CC200 -- a substantial improvement in paper fidelity IF the resource actually covers the 780-subject cohort as inferred.
